attchmntText: Dhunseri Investments Limited has submitted to the Exchange, Outcome of the Board Meeting to consider and approve Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.
voiceSummary: Dhunseri Investments Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 at a Board Meeting held on 12th November 2026. The meeting commenced at 11:40 A.M. and concluded at 01:00 P.M. The Board took on record the Standalone and Consolidated results along with the Limited Review Report from U S Agarwal & Associates. The company will upload the results on its website and publish them in newspapers. Standalone revenue from operations for the half year was 2,178.89 lakh, with a profit after tax of 1,264.19 lakh. Consolidated results include Dhunseri Ventures Limited and Dhunseri Overseas Private Limited. The auditor reported no material misstatements in the financial statements prepared under Ind AS 34.

attchmntText: Dhunseri Investments Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of  Mr. Ramesh Kumar Chandak (DIN: 00029465)  as Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 02, 2026.
Intimation for Appointment of Mrs. Aditi Kanodia (DIN: 10747939) as an Non-Executive Independent Director of the Company.
Dhunseri Investments Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Proceedings of Postal Ballot and Voting Results along with Scrutinizer s Report
